state.description: By default it may not be sent and the transaction is considered immediately closed. If it is set instead the transaction is only initialized and remains open with the possibility of modifying the fields through the PATCH/requests

notifyEmail.description: Allows you to receive the requested service document directly via email once the service has been processed

selectedOptions.description: Allows you to pass options if provided in the 'requestStructure' of the 'document'

state.description: If the transaction is still open, with state at 'NEW', it will not be validated and passed to the system until 'SEARCH' state is passed

search.fieldN.description: Allows you to change the single input field required by the service

notifyEmail.description: Allows you to receive the requested service document directly via email once the service has been processed

selectedOptions.description: Allows you to pass options if provided in the 'requestStructure' of the 'document'

resultId.description: Identifier of the search result we want to choose

readableSearch.description: object with the real names of the input fields

selectedOptions.description: Allows you to pass options if provided in the 'requestStructure' of the 'document'

Search.description: Object to pass all required input fields to generate an output document from the requested service. If you need to insert a file you can opt for the content encoded in base64 or a directly URL

method.description: Indicate through which method you want to receive data with the callback, by default it is POST

field.description: Name of the field containing the callback return data (required with method: POST)

url.description: Url where the callback call will be made

headers.description: contains key:value strings that you want to arrive as headers

data.description: Object to be completed at your convenience with additional data that you can use back with the callback

get.description: Returns the list of all available documents with the prices and required input parameters
